scope_note: Copied from the owner's local workbench on 2026-10-05. A dated web research snapshot that cites only public URLs; prices and terms change, so re-check them before any decision. No tool was bought, installed or signed into.
title: Focused optional art and authoring tools
summary: Figma, Aseprite, Moon Animator2, Krita, Audacity and native Studio alternatives. No optional tool purchased, installed or authenticated.
selection_policy: Add a tool only for a measured workflow gap. Paid tools are optional; no private transfers or purchases authorized.

options.title: Figma

price.billing_toggle: Annual/monthly selection not established from text capture; confirm before purchase

options.license: Proprietary hosted service; account/plan terms apply; community resources have separate licenses
options.benefit: Collaborative component design and visual handoff when a team needs it
options.export_capability: Official static export documentation supports PNG, JPG, SVG and PDF; Dev Mode and MCP are documented with plan limits
options.roblox_boundary: Exports do not create functional ScreenGui interactions, safe areas or controller navigation
options.free_alternative: Repository Luau UI components and native Studio inspection; Figma Starter for optional public/nonprivate design work
options.exact_blocked_capability: Paid shared-library/team features and authenticated Figma MCP; no essential local Roblox UI capability blocked
options.network_and_privacy: Cloud service; do not send private design files without explicit authorization

options.title: Aseprite

price.model: Minimum purchase/pledge for prebuilt1.x binaries per official FAQ

options.license: Aseprite EULA; source-available is not unrestricted redistribution
options.benefit: Dedicated pixel animation, tags, layers and repeatable atlas exports
options.export_capability: Documented batch CLI exports PNG sheets plus JSON metadata, frame ranges and tags; scripting API also documented
options.roblox_boundary: No installed/exercised Aseprite path here. Atlas upload and Roblox playback integration are separate
options.free_alternative: Krita for authored raster/animation work; existing Pillow/FFmpeg for deterministic transforms
options.exact_blocked_capability: Only the Aseprite editor and its specific CLI integration; image processing is already unblocked
options.network_and_privacy: Offline editor after acquisition; obtain only official binaries; no third-party cracked builds

options.title: Moon Animator2

price.context: Sale price shown in official Creator Store search snapshot; direct page has no readable body; checkout revalidation required

options.license: Creator Store purchase terms; per-seat/team/export terms not independently inspected
options.benefit: Candidate specialized Studio animation workspace; benefit requires an actual timed workflow comparison
options.export_capability: Not verified from accessible primary documentation or local execution; no automation claim
options.roblox_boundary: Not purchased, installed, or executed. Do not use similarly named free reuploads
options.free_alternative: Native Roblox Animation Editor plus tested Blender Python/MCP rig pipeline
options.exact_blocked_capability: Only this proprietary plugin workflow; authoring/export can proceed with free tools
options.network_and_privacy: Third-party Studio plugin needs source/permission inspection in disposable place before use

options.title: Krita

price.context: Official direct download; optional store purchases not required

options.license: GPLv3 application; artwork and third-party brush rights assessed separately
options.benefit: Local painting, tiling textures, layered originals and frame animation
options.export_capability: Official manual lists native KRA and image formats; features document PNG/image/video animation export and Python API
options.roblox_boundary: No installed/exercised Krita path; no claimed full GUI automation. Export images still need Roblox ingestion
options.free_alternative: Existing Pillow processing and Blender texture baking handle current diagnostic needs
options.exact_blocked_capability: No setup gate blocked; install only when an authored painting task requires it
options.network_and_privacy: Local app; acquire direct official installer, inspect installer and optional extensions before execution

options.title: Audacity
options.license: GPLv3 application per repository license; audio content has separate rights
options.benefit: Manual listening, trimming and multitrack cleanup using editable local projects
options.export_capability: Official support documents AUP3 projects and WAV/MP3/OGG export; some formats need FFmpeg
options.roblox_boundary: Not installed/exercised by this task. Audio decoding is not hearing; ownership and moderation remain separate
options.free_alternative: Existing FFmpeg/FFprobe for metadata and deterministic offline processing
options.exact_blocked_capability: Optional multitrack editor workflow; local audio fixtures and analysis can proceed
options.network_and_privacy: Use local save/export; cloud upload features are not authorized

options.title: Native Studio UI and Animation Editor
options.license: Roblox software/platform terms; publish/upload actions retain owner-account requirements
options.benefit: Inspect final UI and animation behavior in the actual engine
options.export_capability: Native Animation Editor supports rig timelines and animation publication; publication was intentionally not exercised under setup-only no-upload boundary
options.roblox_boundary: Native fixture execution evidence is in parent Studio reports; this catalog entry only establishes documented capability
options.free_alternative: Selected free route alongside local Blender and repository UI modules
options.exact_blocked_capability: Production asset publication/ownership tests require later explicit authorization
options.network_and_privacy: Use separate unpublished diagnostic scene; never run unknown asset scripts in another game
